newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 14.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd plans to export 18,000 kiloliters of spot gas oil to China this week, becoming the first Japanese company to sell the product to that country. It also plans to conclude a long-term contract with China by the end of March.

Three leading aerial survey firms forecast growth in pre-tax profit for the year to March, thanks to growing demand from local public entities for calculating fixed-asset taxes and strong demand for consulting work. Kokusai Kogyo Co Ltd expects to increase pre-tax profit by 26 percent to 2.9 billion yen, while Pasco Corp expects an increase of 10 percent to 2.2 billion. Asia Air Survey Co Ltd expects an increase of 25 percent to 1.4 billion yen.
